PROPERTY PARTNERS O’BRIEN SWAINE have the pleasure of offering 154 Santry Close, a spacious and beautifully presented three-bedroom semi-detached home, ideally positioned overlooking a large open green in this mature and highly sought-after residential development. Offering generous living accommodation, a converted garage providing valuable additional living space, and an exceptional rear garden, this wonderful home is perfectly suited to growing families and those seeking both comfort and convenience.
The accommodation has been thoughtfully designed to provide bright, well-proportioned living spaces throughout. The welcoming entrance leads to a spacious living room filled with natural light, while the adjoining kitchen and dining area create the perfect setting for everyday family life and entertaining. The converted garage offers a versatile additional room that can easily serve as a family room, home office, playroom or bedroom accommodation, adapting effortlessly to your changing needs.
Upstairs, there are three generous bedrooms, each offering comfortable accommodation, together with a well-appointed family bathroom. The property has been lovingly maintained and offers the ideal balance of space, practicality and warmth.
One of the standout features of this home is its magnificent rear garden. Exceptionally large and beautifully private, it provides an ideal outdoor retreat for families, gardening enthusiasts or those who simply enjoy relaxing and entertaining outdoors. The front of the property enjoys an enviable position overlooking an attractive open green, creating a wonderful sense of space and a safe environment for children to play.
The location is second to none. Santry Close is a well-established and popular neighbourhood with every conceivable amenity close at hand, including excellent schools, local shops, cafés, sports clubs and parks. Dublin City University, Omni Shopping Centre and Santry Demesne are all within easy reach. Commuters will particularly appreciate the superb transport links, with Dublin Airport, the M50 motorway and the Port Tunnel all just minutes away, providing quick and convenient access to the city centre and beyond.
154 Santry Close presents a rare opportunity to acquire a substantial family home in one of Dublin 9's most convenient and desirable locations. Combining generous accommodation, a versatile layout, a beautiful rear garden and an outstanding position overlooking open green space, this is a property that is sure to impress from the moment you arrive.
